Class GridArea

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.layout.grid.GridArea
public final class GridArea extends Object
Parses and validates CSS grid-template-areas style layout definitions.

Area names must be alphanumeric identifiers starting with a letter. Use "." for empty cells. Named areas must form contiguous rectangles. 

GridArea areas = GridArea.parse("A A B", "A A C", "D D D");
// A spans columns 0-1, rows 0-1
// B spans column 2, row 0
// C spans column 2, row 1
// D spans columns 0-2, row 2

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static GridArea parse(String... rowTemplates)
      Parses area template strings into a GridArea.

      Each string represents a row; tokens are space-separated area names. All rows must have the same number of tokens (columns). Named areas must form contiguous rectangles. Use "." for empty cells.

      Parameters:
      rowTemplates - the row templates (e.g., "A A B", "A A C")
      Returns:
      the parsed GridArea
      Throws:
      LayoutException - if the template is invalid
